name: Miss Clue: Secret of the Haunted Garden
storyline:
Mrs. Danforth has been a widow for many years and circumstances are conspiring to force her to sell her family home, the Dyer Mansion, and everything she holds dear. As Jane helps Mrs. Danforth prepare her house for sale, will she be able to unravel the decades old mystery that haunts the Dyer Mansion and discover the secrets that will save Mrs. Danforth's house and her future?
This haunting Halloween tale challenges Jane from the beginning when she encounters a mysterious figure digging in the garden of the Dyer Mansion. Can death keep Jane from discovering the past which still haunts the present in Jane's most exciting Halloween adventure? Only time will tell!
